if (frame_len != len) return NULL;","note":"The parser trusts the serialized frame-length field to validate the buffer size and uses it to accept the crafted frame layout."},{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2/blosc/schunk.c","function":"blosc2_schunk_open_sframe","line":262,"var":"schunk","code":"blosc2_frame_to_schunk(frame, false)","note":"The validated frame is converted into a super-chunk object whose metadata and chunk table are derived from the attacker-controlled frame contents."},{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2/tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_frame.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":32,"var":"nchunk","code":"for (i = 0, nchunk = 0; nchunk < schunk->nchunks-1; nchunk++)","note":"The fuzzer iterates over every advertised chunk index from the parsed frame, so malformed chunk counts or offsets are exercised during decompression."},{"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2/blosc/schunk.c","function":"blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk","line":523,"var":"src","code":"src = schunk->data[nchunk];","note":"For non-frame-backed chunks, the code fetches the compressed chunk pointer from the super-chunk table using the attacker-influenced chunk index."},{"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2/blosc/schunk.c","function":"blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk","line":531,"var":"nbytes_","code":"int nbytes_ = sw32_(src + BLOSC2_CHUNK_NBYTES);","note":"The decompressor reads chunk header fields from the compressed chunk buffer; if the frame metadata is inconsistent, this read can go past the allocated chunk boundary and trigger the heap-buffer-overflow read."}]
